Modbus.Title: ED-THCV-PBLS5-MB
Modbus.HintText:
Room sensor with communication interface Flush-mounted design: surface-mounted version on request Measured variable: Temperature: 0 to 50°C Measured variable: relative humidity: 0 to 100 % Measured variable: CO2: 400 to 2000 ppm Measured variable: mixed gases VOC: 0 to 5000 ppm RS-485 interface for Modbus RTU Version: V2.1 Protection class: IP20
Depending on the device variant, not all sensors or operating elements are fitted and indicate a value of 0.

ModbusCmd.Title: I_Temperature - Analogue sensor
ModbusCmd.HintText: Value range: -1000 to 5000 Physical value: -10.00 to 50.00 °C

ModbusCmd.Title: I_Relative humidity - Analogue sensor
ModbusCmd.HintText: Value range: 0 to 10000 Physical value: 0 to 100.00 % r.H.

ModbusCmd.Title: IC_CO2 concentration - Analogue sensor
ModbusCmd.HintText: Value range: 0 to 40000 Physical value: 0 to 40 000 ppm3

ModbusCmd.Title: I_TVOC concentration - Analogue sensor
ModbusCmd.HintText: Value range: 0 to 65 000 Physical quantity: 0 to 65,000 ppb

ModbusCmd.Title: I_Temperature - Setpoint
ModbusCmd.Comment: All room sensors with a “P” in the product designation have an adjusting wheel for setting the temperature setpoint.

ModbusCmd.Title: O_Temperature Offset
ModbusCmd.HintText: Value range: -200 to 200 Physical value: ± 2.00 K

ModbusCmd.Title: O_Reset
ModbusCmd.HintText: The device is restarted when writing to 1
